fields.name: Your full name
fields.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
fields.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Avoid your name or email.

passwordProblems.too_common: This password is too common. Choose something harder to guess.
passwordProblems.contains_identifier: Don't use your name or email in your password.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email or password doesn't match. Check them and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. For your security, wait a few minutes and try again, or reset your password.
errors.offline: You're offline. Connect to the internet to continue.
errors.network: We couldn't reach AcademyBee. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

login.title: Sign in to {academy}
login.body: For the academy's staff, parents and students. Parents and students continue to the Family Hub.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter the email you use at {academy}. We'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If that email has an account at {academy}, a reset link is on its way. It expires in 1 hour. Check your spam folder if it doesn't arrive in a few minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.body: You'll be signed out of every device, then you can sign in with the new password.
reset.doneBody: You've been signed out of every device. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidTitle: This link doesn't work any more
reset.invalidBody: Reset links expire after 1 hour and work only once. Ask for a new one.

invite.title: Join {academy}
invite.body: You've been invited to join {academy} as {roles}.
invite.newAccountBody: Create your AcademyBee account to accept.
invite.existingBody: You already have an AcademyBee account. Enter its password to join {academy}.
invite.invalidBody: It may have expired, been replaced by a newer invitation, or already been accepted. Ask {academy} to send you a new one.
invite.alreadyMember: You're already a member of {academy}. Sign in instead.

session.expiredBody: Your session has ended. Sign in again to pick up where you left off — nothing on this page is lost.

home.title: Signed in to {academy}
home.body: You're signed in as {name}. Your workspace opens here as each part of AcademyBee arrives.

login.title: Sign in to the Family Hub
login.body: For parents and students: every academy your family belongs to, in one place.

handoff.working: Signing you in to the Family Hub…
handoff.failedBody: Sign-in links work once and only for a minute. Sign in again to continue.

home.title: Hello, {name}
home.body: You're signed in to the AcademyBee Family Hub.
home.empty: You're not linked to an academy right now. Ask your academy to invite you again.

login.title: AcademyBee console
login.body: For AcademyBee staff. Sign-in needs your password and a code from your authenticator app.

enrol.title: Set up two-step sign-in
enrol.body: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password. Then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
enrol.qrAlt: QR code to add AcademyBee to your authenticator app
enrol.manualKey: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app instead:

codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.body: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. You won't see them again, so store them somewhere safe, like a password manager.

verify.title: Enter your sign-in code
verify.body: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for AcademyBee.
verify.useCode: Use a code from my app
verify.recoveryBody: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-step sign-in. Each code works once.

errors.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Check that your phone's time is set automatically and try the newest code.
errors.expired: That took too long. Sign in again to continue.

setPassword.title: Choose your console password
setPassword.body: Next you'll set up two-step sign-in with an authenticator app.
setPassword.invalidBody: Set-password links expire after 24 hours and work once. Ask an AcademyBee admin for a new one.
